item.title: Nook 1.0.0
item.description:
What's New in Nook 1.0.0

  • Interactive 3D Miniature Environment: Direct physical object interaction with RealityKit entities across desk, bed, shelves, audio lounge, and floor.
  • Physical Drag & Drop: Smooth pick-up elevation, surface height snapping, physical settling, and boundary wall constraints.
  • Movable Prop Controls: 45° incremental rotation, constrained scaling (0.85x–1.25x), and native Undo/Redo integration.
  • Companion Cat Reactivity: Cookie looks curiously at moving objects, purrs when petted, and keeps you company.
  • Local-First Guarantee: SwiftData offline storage with persistent room coordinates and Zero-Cloud privacy.
